# Which children should I enrol to make the most from my space?

> Free tool for childcare center and daycare owners: enter floor space, ratios, tuition and waiting lists by age group and get the enrolment mix with the highest weekly profit, checked exactly, with every staffing step shown. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
